# Filter all vehicles from the same model year
same_year_vehicles = df[df['modelyear'] == vehicle_model_year]

print(f"Number of vehicles in model year {vehicle_model_year}: {len(same_year_vehicles)}")
print(f"\nHorsepower values for model year {vehicle_model_year}:")
print(same_year_vehicles['horsepower'].values)

# Calculate average horsepower using arithmetic mean
average_horsepower = same_year_vehicles['horsepower'].mean()
print(f"\nAverage horsepower: {average_horsepower}")

# Calculate population standard deviation (not sample standard deviation)
# Population std uses N in denominator, not N-1
horsepower_values = same_year_vehicles['horsepower'].values
population_std = np.std(horsepower_values, ddof=0)  # ddof=0 for population std
print(f"Population standard deviation: {population_std}")

# Round to two decimal places
average_horsepower_rounded = round(average_horsepower, 2)
population_std_rounded = round(population_std, 2)

print(f"\nRounded average horsepower: {average_horsepower_rounded}")
print(f"Rounded population standard deviation: {population_std_rounded}")
